corrections.finding: 'alone' on A. fischeri is stronger than the source (hatchlings select it from seawater full of other microbes). 'a bright glow comes only at a society's own density, no one cell glowing bright alone' is stronger than the source: a second ain system gives lower light at middling density. 'shares a small molecule outward and senses it inward' is not in the sources (they say lux quorum sensing). 'dawn' should be morning, and the 90 percent is roughly, up to 95 on the Euprymna page. 'moonlight' is not in the source (light hitting the top of the mantle). 'dissolves on the surface over it' is unclear (source: hides the silhouette from below). The 10 percent replenish before the following night.
corrections.fixed_text: A Hawaiian bobtail squid hatches with no bacteria, and from seawater full of other microbes it selects Aliivibrio fischeri; the bacteria sense their own density by quorum sensing, a bright glow comes at high density and a lower light at middling density; each morning the squid vents roughly 90 percent of them (up to 95 percent on the Euprymna page), and the remaining 10 percent re-form the society before the following night; the glow matches the light striking the top of the mantle, hiding the squid's silhouette from below, a squid and its bacteria orienting as one same-existing-society to a light in neither of them.
